title: Launches tracked by WB-57, F-104 and NRO satellites

tellings.quote: at that point it's intercepted by a WB-57 run out of Houston by a good friend of mine which is National Reconnaissance Office works with Taylor.

plain: Something launched from Cape Canaveral, the Florida rocket site, was followed by a WB-57, a high-flying research plane flown out of Houston, along with an F-104 jet and satellites of the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs show up around him, tells this, and he says the plane was run by a good friend of his who works with the reconnaissance office and with a man named Timothy Taylor. If true, it would mean these launches were closely watched by government spy assets.
